items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] People like Tommy Ladner and, of course, Louie and different people.

ctx.x: But I don't remember hearing anything different about that than what I heard on the Monk Talking records, those three sides that came in.
People like Tommy Ladner and, of course, Louie and different people.

But I do want to say about this episode in the bar that this was a typical example of a kind of playful mood that Bonk would get into with people. He would... He had a very devilish side to his personality when he would, just for the heck of it, he'd start giving somebody a hard time with kind of tongue in cheek. Yeah. But yet he'd make you feel awful uncomfortable for a minute, you know, because you didn't know how to take or how to handle the situation, you know.
